payload.description:
Description:

Vice President, Finance and Administration / Chief Financial Officer

Division: Finance and Administration

Reports To: President

Direct Reports:
• Controller
• Executive Director, Procurement and Administrative Services
• Executive Director, Public Safety
• Executive Director, Facilities Management
• Internal Auditor

Position Summary

Our post-secondary education client is seeking an accomplished and strategic financial executive to serve as its next Vice President, Finance and Administration / Chief Financial Officer.

As the chief financial and administrative officer and a member of the President’s Cabinet, the CFO provides executive leadership, strategic direction, and institutional stewardship for the school's financial operations, administrative services, public safety, and facilities.

This position ensures the responsible management of institutional resources while advancing the school's mission, vision, and strategic priorities. payload.title: Director of Human Resources
payload.description:
Description:

Director Human Resources
Due to continued business growth and expansion, and internal leadership movement, our client is seeking an experienced, strategic, and dynamic Director, Human Resources to lead the people agenda for their Toronto site.

As the senior HR leader for the site, this individual will serve as a key member of both the Site Leadership Team and the broader global HR organization. The role is responsible for partnering with business leaders to drive organizational effectiveness, foster a high-performance culture, support transformational growth, and ensure the development of a sustainable and engaged workforce.

The Director, Human Resources will play a critical role in aligning people strategies with business priorities, influencing organizational direction, and enabling operational success within a rapidly growing and highly dynamic manufacturing environment.

As the HR leader for a 24/7 manufacturing facility, this role requires a highly visible, hands-on, and engaged onsite presence. The successful candidate will demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to provide effective HR leadership and support across the site's operation

payload.title: Physics Educator
payload.description:
About the role

Type: Full Time

Placement: Physics Educator

(Exact grade and domain/subject placement will be determined after appointment)

 

Description:

We are a Preschool to Grade 12 school in the city of Rajkot (Gujarat) founded by Harvard alums. Our unique pedagogy, the Northstar Approach, is a research-based approach to learning and teaching that helps students achieve their highest potential by exploring and making discoveries about themselves and their world. We are currently looking for passionate educators to join us. Please go through our website to know more about us.

 

Responsibilities:

  1. Plan and teach lessons following the Northstar Approach.

  2. Use a wide range of technologies and creative teaching styles.

  3. Regularly participate in collaborative curriculum planning and development, and work with colleagues to deliver effective team teaching when possible.

  4. Develop and implement relevant assessments for both formative and summative evaluations as well as for uncovering student’s potential initial misconceptions.

  5. Keep parents informed about student progress and attend parent meetings.

  6. Be a champion and disseminator of the Northstar Approach inside and outside the school.
